units.function: Focused CLI test for browser-launch behavior used by board authentication, including successful spawn, asynchronous missing-opener failure and synchronous spawn failure.
units.dependencyDirection: The Vitest suite mocks node:child_process.spawn before importing the board-auth client and supplies a minimal EventEmitter child process; it tests only the exported openUrl behavior.
units.keyDataModels: A URL string and a boolean launch outcome; child-process spawn and error events are treated as the platform boundary.
units.lifecycle: Request URL open; receive a child spawn event and resolve true, or catch synchronous/asynchronous process-launch failure and resolve false without terminating a headless CLI.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 3/3 tests on 2026-08-19 and CLI no-emit TypeScript passed. The regression meaningfully covers Node's asynchronous child-process error behavior, but omits platform command selection, close-before-spawn, duplicate events, timeout, URL validation/schemes and authentication-state handling after launch failure.
units.designRationale: Interactive authentication should degrade gracefully in containers or SSH sessions where no graphical browser opener exists, allowing a fallback URL flow rather than crashing on an unhandled child-process error.
units.companyOsProblem: Managed-cloud and self-hosted Company OS authentication/bootstrap flows must work both with desktop browsers and headless enterprise nodes without changing identity responsibility or leaking one-time authentication URLs.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the graceful headless-failure regression pattern in the deployment/Identity adapter layer. Keep URL construction and allowed schemes/hosts server- or adapter-owned, provide an explicit manual fallback and avoid placing browser-launch concerns in Company OS core/application.
units.responsibilityConflict: None in the boolean helper itself, but authentication launch success is not identity proof. Company OS must not equate opening a URL with completing human authentication, consent, audience binding or an accountable session.
evidence: 9cd62cf3bb7b9e86f0b08894a1c48bbdb79a9488 fix(cli): handle headless browser-open failure in board auth (#8328)
2026-08-19 focused Vitest: 1 file and 3 tests passed
securityFindings: The test passes only a fixed HTTPS URL and does not prove rejection of file, javascript, data or custom schemes, malformed URLs, control characters or attacker-controlled opener arguments.
No allowlisted host, callback binding, state/nonce/PKCE or token-audience behavior is covered; those belong to the owning board-auth/Identity unit.
The fake child does not model close/exit before spawn, repeated spawn/error events or a process that never emits, leaving potential unresolved-promise and race behavior untested.
One-time authentication URLs can be sensitive; the suite does not assess logging, terminal history, clipboard or manual-fallback disclosure.
